interface.signature: audit_schema(plan_bytes:bytes, item:str, files:dict[str,bytes], prefix:list[dict], original_dm21:bytes, deadline_check:callable) -> list[str]
interface.prefix_record: plain dict with exactly {item, files, audit_bytes}; one per preceding plan item in plan order; DATA requires prefix == []
interface.types: plan_bytes/original_dm21/file values/audit_bytes must be type bytes exactly (bytearray, memoryview and subclasses rejected); files and records plain dict, prefix plain list, item str
interface.caps: artifact <= gate CAP 16 MiB; audit_bytes <= 1 MiB; original_dm21 <= 1 MiB; plan_bytes <= 16 MiB before hashing; gate source <= 1 MiB
interface.deadline_check: Zero-argument callable, gate tick convention: returns None while budget remains and raises on expiry. Any Exception raised, or any non-None return value (including True/False), is a deadline failure -> X5. Called at entry, exit, every prefix record and around every parse/validation/read boundary, and passed (wrapped) as verify_controls' tick.
interface.failure_mapping: Every Exception (invalid inputs, plan pin, loader read/digest/compile/exec, offline snapshot rejection, gate Failure, KeyError/TypeError/IndexError/ValueError/OSError/RecursionError/MemoryError, deadline) -> ['X5 RESULT_SCHEMA']; [] only when _replay returns True and the final deadline check passes. Non-Exception BaseExceptions (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) propagate and never yield [].

loader.module_import: No imports, no reads and no state at module import: only constants, one exception class and function definitions. Stdlib imports (hashlib, os, stat) occur inside functions at explicit call time.
loader.source_read: Each audit_schema call reads only GATE_PATH via _anchored_source_bytes: absolute normalized path walked from a retained '/' fd with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW parents, leaf O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW, fstat regular/nlink==1/size<=1 MiB before reading, <=64 KiB blocks with cap+1 consumption, post-read dev/ino/size/nlink/mtime_ns/ctime_ns identity and size==bytes-read, close, then deadline check.
loader.verification: sha256(source) == 8d04c5ce...; plan.programs.gate.algorithm/algorithm_sha256 and plan.pins must name the same path/digest.
loader.execution: compile(source, GATE_PATH, 'exec', dont_inherit=True); exec into a fresh dict {__name__: 'ext4_gate_pinned_for_beta_schema_audit_v1', __file__: GATE_PATH}; gate main guard inert; the name 'main' is never referenced or called. Fresh namespace per call; nothing is cached or registered in sys.modules. The exec'd gate imports stdlib os, sys, stat, json, hashlib, math, time (process-global module cache only, no I/O).
loader.transcribed_orchestration: Only the per-item structure of the gate main audited-prefix loop (ext4_gate.py lines 279-321: audit schema, DATA, search and gate branches) is transcribed so it runs on supplied bytes; no scientific algorithm is duplicated.

offline_snapshot.label: OFFLINE SNAPSHOT EVALUATION - not a real-path reader smoke and never kernel or filesystem evidence
offline_snapshot.binding: Serves the caller-supplied original_dm21 bytes only for path == plan.dm21_path (exact str), only while sha256(original_dm21) == plan.dm21_sha256 (checked at binding and at every read) and len <= requested int cap; every other path or cap failure raises OSError -> X5. The pinned verify_controls requests only plan.dm21_path.

validated_per_call: plan bytes type/cap and SHA-256 == 254b44c3...; strict gate parse; twenty unique jobs; order == job items; final_gate == last item and kind gate; gate program pin consistency; calibration items disjoint from the plan
item is one of the twenty plan items; CAL-beta/CAL-joint and unknown names rejected
prefix length == plan position; each record exact keys, item == plan order item, files exactly the declared names as bytes within cap, audit_bytes bytes within 1 MiB

each prefix audit: gate canonical bytes with exact AKEYS; format ext-search-job-audit-v1, item, plan_sha256, verdict AUDITED_PASS, settled true (bool), exit_code exact plan int, declared_output_sha256 exactly the digests of the supplied declared bytes, receipt_sha256 lowercase 64-hex, auditor/at nonempty str, notes str

DATA (current or prefix): canonical maker result {status OK, reason null, files == MFILES order, manifest_sha256 == digest(manifest.json), finite float wall}; canonical manifest {format ext-search-controls-v1, dm21_input_sha256 == plan.dm21_sha256, exact per-file sha256/bytes, control names N6..BAD_PIN}; gate verify_controls on the offline snapshot (original DM21 pin/shape/DM, exact control bytes, Singer and DM21 planted extensions, independently derived control/chunk definitions)

search (current or prefix): audited DATA dependency; planned status consistent with the derived control premise (COMPLETE_ZERO/COMPLETE_CONTAINS -> COMPLETE, NOT_DM, INPUT_PIN_MISMATCH); gate validate_result (exact 17-key canonical schema, program/status/reason site, per-program/per-status typed metadata incl. beta all-null and joint m0/lo0/hi1 INPUT_PIN_MISMATCH, early-error empty payload and digest, COMPLETE beta/joint extras, <=4096 sorted unique solutions with direct EXT(D) and fixed-chunk checks, actual solution digest, exact chunk coverage/counts, input_sha256 == digest(actual DATA raw)); program_sha256 == plan.programs[program].algorithm_sha256 (a319a4be... beta, d7800fdd... joint, also present in plan.pins); N6/N12 zero solutions; P21/P57 contain the known deleted row; compare_to peer audited and exact solutions + solutions_sha256 equality

gate (current or prefix): canonical GKEYS; status OK, reason null, self, plan_sha256, exact ordered prefix, all_as_expected true, qualified true only for final G-CONTROLS and false otherwise, target_claim UNEVALUATED, finite float wall_s, items exactly equal to the {item, problems: [], artifacts} records recomputed from the actual supplied prefix in order
stricter_than_gate: result program_sha256 must equal the pinned algorithm digest, not only hex64
planned job status must match the independently derived control premise
exact prefix/record/files/bytes types and declared-name sets (the gate reads declared names from directories)
any failure anywhere in the prefix or current item is X5 (the gate records per-item problems)
boundaries: [] is a schema predicate only. It never establishes receipts, actual exits, captures, settlement, /bin/date records, source/input pins or runtime provenance; canonical prior-audit syntax proves none of them. Parent binds those separately (X1-X4, X6, X7) and alone decides.
The current item has no audit; X5 checks its declared output bytes only.
The pinned gate's own runtime re-hash of plan.pins and its anchored directory/audit reads are not reproduced; X7 and the parent readers own them.
Offline snapshot evaluation of verify_controls is not a real-path reader smoke.
A qualified final G-CONTROLS means controls only; target_claim stays UNEVALUATED; no six-MOLS39/CFR21 scientific acceptance, no canonical audit, release or admission follows from [].
